qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted regulated electric and gas transmission/distribution franchise territories across Pennsylvania, Kentucky, and Rhode Island. Natural monopoly grid infrastructure with formulaic cost-plus rate base recovery and authorized ROE of ~9.5-10.0%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Pure-play regulated electric and gas utility holding company across Pennsylvania, Kentucky, and Rhode Island following successful portfolio repositioning. However, heavy grid modernization capex ($4.03B capex vs $2.63B OCF in FY2025) creates a $1.4B free cash flow deficit and elevates long-term debt to $18.0B (15.2x net income) with thin 2.63x interest coverage, requiring continuous external capital market financing.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue of $9.04B, EBIT of $2,129M, and net income of $1,181M. 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 4.78%. Balance sheet carries $17.99B in long-term debt against $1,071M cash, resulting in 15.2x debt/NI (threshold <=4.0x) and 2.63x interest coverage (EBIT $2,129M / Interest $808M, threshold >5.0x). Capex of $4,030M outpaced OCF of $2,629M by $1.4B in FY2025.
